originalPrompt: Continuous medium-tracking sequence in a sunlit art studio. First, an artist dips a wooden paintbrush into a glass jar of deep blue watercolor, causing ink plumes to bloom in the water. Next, without a cut, the artist lifts the wet brush and applies a single smooth stroke onto a clean canvas. Finally, the artist sets the brush down on a wooden easel ledge and steps back slightly. Consistent natural lighting, seamless chronological progression, rigid brush geometry throughout.
